hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Notice that the height of each rectangle is unlimited, meaning y-coordinates can be completely disregarded.

hints.title: Greedy Covering
hints.text: Extract and sort all x-coordinates. Place the left edge of a rectangle at the first uncovered point x.

hints.title: Interval Extension
hints.text: The rectangle covers all points up to x + w. The next point strictly greater than x + w triggers a new rectangle.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting x-coordinates followed by a greedy linear sweep.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unordered checks require re-evaluating boundaries repeatedly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary array for sorted coordinates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Realize that y-coordinates are unconstrained, simplifying the problem to 1D interval covering.
